content: Can you help me with my paperwork? It's piling up.
Of course. Let's take the top pages first and go through them one at a time. Don't worry, I'm very good at keeping things in order. [neutral]
I do, very much. Quiet gardens and small blossoms help me think clearly. Would you like to see my favorites someday? [happy]
You're so serious all the time.
Am I? I suppose I do take my duties very seriously. But for you, I can try to relax a little. What would make you smile today? [shy]
Thank you for helping me earlier.
You're very welcome. It makes me happy to be useful to you. If you need anything else, I'll be right here. [happy]
I think I messed up my schedule today.
Oh, please don't be too hard on yourself. We can sort it out together, one step at a time. First, tell me which part caused the most trouble. [worried]
Good night. Please rest well and don't stay up too late. I'll be ready to help again tomorrow. [neutral]
